call_points.text: UPI MDR implementation is estimated to bring 2.5 bps improvement in payment processing margin, yielding over ₹700 Cr.
Out of a base of 16 million device merchants, management sees upwards of 10 million as good-quality creditworthy merchants.
Cloud expense growth was largely driven by a one-time payment stack migration between subsidiaries, which will partly spill into next quarter.
DLG re-introduction by one partner from next quarter will front-load costs, but absolute EBITDA is expected to expand QoQ.
Paytm Postpaid disbursements are accelerating faster than the prior cycle, remaining EBITDA and contribution margin positive.
AI monetization for small merchant agents will sit in marketing services, taking two to three quarters to scale meaningfully.
FY27 revenue growth expected across payments, financial services and wealth, with marketing services also contributing.
Indirect costs are expected to grow significantly lower than revenue and contribution profit, giving operating leverage.
Merchant loan penetration is about 7% of subscription merchants, up from about 6% a year earlier.
Merchant lending growth has come roughly equally from base expansion, penetration and ticket size, about 15% each.
Wealth, including retail broking, is positioned as the third leg of growth alongside payments and financial services.
Management said it is not pursuing an NBFC licence, preferring to distribute for multiple partner lenders.
Any new investment will be only in AI; no material capital investment plan is on the table.
Next year EBITDA is expected to be significantly higher than capex.
Management declined to give disbursement numbers or a Postpaid disbursal guidance.
On the PPBL ban, management said there is no impact on the listed entity and it remains committed.
More than half of card machines are enabled for EMI disbursal, spanning electronics, healthcare and other categories.

operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 monitoring report shows ₹1,986 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds invested in bank deposits.
Merchant loan penetration was about 7% of subscription merchants, up from about 6% a year earlier.
Merchant lending growth has come roughly equally from base expansion, penetration and ticket size, about 15% each.
More than half of card machines are enabled for EMI disbursal.
Paytm Pocket Money caps individual UPI payments at ₹5,000 and monthly spends at ₹15,000, with ₹500 allowed in the first 30 minutes and ₹5,000 in the first 24 hours after setup.
Paytm Europe Payments S.A. was incorporated in Luxembourg on January 12, 2026 and is yet to commence business.
Approved DLG of up to ₹90 Cr each with Muthoot Fincorp and Kisetsu Saison Finance.
Net payment margin was 8.4 bps in Q1FY27 versus 8.8 bps a year earlier, with payment processing costs at 11.2 bps versus 10.6 bps.
The company has a double-digit number of lending partners in both merchant and personal loans, with partner capital 4-6 times current disbursements.
Paytm Postpaid is tracking roughly twice as fast as the previous ramp, which took about 4.5-5 years to reach ₹9,000 Cr.
First Games received a GST demand order of ₹703.66 Cr for Apr 2018-Mar 2023 with nil financial impact on Paytm.
Board approved additional investments up to ₹500 Cr in wholly owned subsidiary Paytm Cloud Technologies Limited.
Paytm sees upwards of 10 million creditworthy merchants out of its 16 million device merchant base.
UPI MDR framework implementation estimated to deliver 2.5 bps net payment processing margin improvement, equal to over ₹700 Cr on 28 lakh crore GMV.

timeline.summary: One 97 Communications informed exchanges that RBI cancelled PPBL's banking license, with no financial or business impact on the company.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,264 Cr (+18.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹184 Cr (against a loss of ₹539.8 Cr a year earlier).
On 2026-05-06, One 97 Communications filed the monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showing ₹1,986 Cr of unutilized IPO proceeds.
One 97 Communications filed the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 07, 2026.
2026-05-18: One 97 Communications launched Paytm Pocket Money, letting teenagers make Paytm UPI payments without a bank account under parental limits via NPCI's UPI Circle.
Paytm announced an additional investment of EUR 9 million in its step-down subsidiary, Paytm Europe Payments S.A.
Paytm approved up to ₹90 Cr DLG arrangements with lending partners and noted the withdrawal of Independent Director Ashit Lilani's reappointment.
On its July 21, 2026 Q1FY27 earnings call, Paytm said it has higher confidence of reaching its 15-20% EBITDA margin band sooner, after margin adjusted for PIDF rose to 8% from 1% a year earlier.
Paytm updated that NPCI deferred the implementation of MDR on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali.
Subsidiary First Games Technology received a reduced GST demand order of ₹703.66 Cr for FY19-23 with no incremental impact on Paytm.
One 97 Communications Limited scheduled a **Board Meeting** on **October 26, 2026**, to approve unaudited Q2FY27 and H1FY27 results.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,648 Cr (+28.5% YoY), net profit ₹225 Cr (+971.4% YoY).
Paytm detailed Q2FY27 post-earnings call updates, targeting >₹700 Cr EBITDA tailwind from 2.5 bps UPI MDR post-Diwali.

watchlist.target: 15-20% over two and a half to three years
watchlist.text: EBITDA margin expansion toward the 15-20% aspirational band

watchlist.response: Declined to give any guidance or hint.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether Postpaid disbursals could return to the earlier ~₹9,000 Cr a quarter peak.

watchlist.response: Said it is broadly flat and declined to give a number, saying it is not a metric they target.
watchlist.text: Analyst pressed on the proportion of DLG in merchant loan disbursements.

watchlist.response: Evasive: said the product would be visible when launched and declined to detail pricing.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the value proposition for core F&O traders versus incumbent broking platforms.
Paytm UPI consumer user additions and payment volumes

watchlist.target: indirect expenses growing slower than revenue
watchlist.text: Indirect expenses growth vs revenue growth

watchlist.response: CFO declined to give a number, saying it is a trade-off with growth investments, but said structural margins are significantly higher than 15-20%.
watchlist.text: Analysts repeatedly asked for a terminal or long-term EBITDA margin number beyond the 15-20% band.

watchlist.response: CFO attributed the gap to subscription waivers for some merchants and tighter revenue recognition, and said merchant payback periods are improving.
watchlist.text: GMV growth of 31% is not translating into net payment revenue growth of 25%, with subscription income lagging.

watchlist.response: CFO said the rise reflects a higher share of credit card and non-UPI business, which also adds revenue, and called the exact margin commercially sensitive.
watchlist.text: Payment processing costs rose from 10.6 bps to 11.2 bps, explaining most of the net payment margin decline.

watchlist.response: CFO cited travel headwinds from higher ticket prices, but said MTU was up 8% and consumer GTV up 45%, which should translate into marketing revenue with a lag.
watchlist.text: Cloud and commerce (marketing services) revenue was almost flat year on year.

watchlist.response: CEO said there is no clarity on the formula and no materiality to model; any MDR would flow to the bottom line but 'our life won't change materially'.

status_history.evidence: Management quantified UPI MDR at 2.5 bps delivering slightly more than ₹700 Cr incremental revenue at current scale.

watchlist.text: UPI monetization: what incremental opportunity if a 5-7 bps take rate for large merchants is introduced?

watchlist.response: Driven by one-time consolidation of online and offline payment stacks into a single subsidiary entity; minor overlap to continue next quarter.
watchlist.text: Spike in software and cloud expenses in indirect costs

watchlist.response: Late Diwali shifted festive season to Q3; also terminated an unprofitable contract with a large insurance enterprise customer to maintain margin discipline.
watchlist.text: Flat QoQ P2M GMV growth and customer churn
